audit.method: Read from the full term sheet by one AI reviewer, then checked against it twice by independent AI reviewers: first every line of the record against the document, then the document section by section against the record. Not signed off by a person. Every quote is looked up in the PDF text each time the tool runs.
audit.open_points:
Final record: C:\Users\AFarid\Documents\Hackathon\key_credit_terms\data\audited\accenture_2026.json. Checker: structure OK, 74 exact, 1 loose, 0 on another page, 0 missing (of 75). A diff against the first-audit record shows only the changes listed. All 11 page images were opened and match the dump.

The document-to-record walk found no term missing from a row, none in the wrong row and no wrong figure. Every number matches the page and belongs to this facility. In particular, the Administrative Agent is Bank of America (JPMorgan is agent only under the Existing Credit Agreement and Syndication Agent here), and the $2.0bn increase cap is the combined cap with the Five-Year Facility.

First auditor's doubts, as decided from the document:
1. The six 'None' rows and the budget row stay stated. The Covenants paragraph says 'and limited to' items (i) to (xii), which is a closed list under the brief even though the same sentence says 'substantially similar to the Existing Credit Agreement'.
2. Mandatory Prepayment stays by_reference. Change of control is addressed as an event of default, but the ownership trigger the row asks for is left to the Existing Credit Agreement.
3. Jurisdiction of Topco stays 'Ireland (Accenture plc ...)' as a disclosed derived point.
4. The term-out option stays out of the Facility line; it is in Maturity Date.
5. The 277-character first Facility quote is kept. It is verbatim and contiguous on page 1, and is the only way to carry both the amount and 'up to the entire amount' within three quotes.
6. The loose arranger quote is kept; it is interrupted only by the label line 'JOINT BOOKRUNNERS:'.
7. The three lines at 254 to 262 characters are kept; all are under the 420 limit.
8. The tail of the pari passu covenant cannot be quoted in the Other row: the page-5 part of the list is 660 characters against 600 for two quotes. It is quoted in full under Collateral/Security.
9. Pricing, the default rate, Required Lenders (more than 50%) and governing law (New York) have no template row and are not recorded in rows. Governing law is in the Topco note.

What the term sheet cannot resolve:
(a) It never says Accenture plc is the parent of the Borrowers.
(b) The change of control trigger and all lien, merger and asset-sale baskets, reporting deadlines and the interest cover definition are in the Existing Credit Agreement only.
(c) Barclays' commitment is not in this exhibit; the Commitment Letter is not part of the PDF.
(d) How much of the shared $2.0bn increase cap is available to this facility depends on increases under the Five-Year Facility (Exhibit A, not in the PDF).
(e) The term sheet does not say in so many words that acquisitions, distributions, debt, loans, guarantees or junior debt payments are unrestricted.

Cross-record consistency: other first-audit records use both 'see [Other]' (Aon, Delta) and 'see Other' (Fluence). I changed this record only, to 'see the Other row'.

doc.title: EXHIBIT B - SUMMARY OF TERMS AND CONDITIONS - ACCENTURE CAPITAL INC., ACCENTURE GLOBAL CAPITAL DESIGNATED ACTIVITY COMPANY AND ACCENTURE FINANCE LIMITED - $2,000,000,000 364-DAY REVOLVING CREDIT FACILITY
doc.notes: Exhibit B (Summary of Terms and Conditions) to a commitment letter for a new $2.0bn 364-day revolving credit facility for three Accenture borrowers, guaranteed by Accenture plc; it is marked as a CS&M draft of 03/26/2026 and the Closing Date is left blank ('April [●], 2026'). The terms are on pages 1-8 in a label / value layout, and Addendum I (facility fee, interest rates and ratings-based pricing grid) is on pages 9-11. It is a new facility, not an amendment, and has no existing / proposed columns; representations, covenants, events of default, assignments and the increase option are stated to be 'substantially similar to the Existing Credit Agreement' (Credit Agreement dated as of May 14, 2024), so baskets, definitions and reporting deadlines beyond the listed items are not given. The Commitment Letter itself and its Exhibit A (the companion Five-Year Facility, which shares the increase cap) are not part of the document, and no lender commitment amounts are stated.
